description: Control Plane Core 3.1 audit-only hooks; authorizes=false and trust remains pending separate adoption.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env -i LC_ALL=C PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /bin/sh -c 'root=$(/usr/bin/env -i LC_ALL=C PATH=/usr/bin:/bin GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 /usr/bin/git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 1; exec "$root/scripts/control-plane" __hook__'
